name: Baal Berith
overview: The Scriptures reveal Baal Berith as a false god worshiped by the Israelites after the death of Gideon, highlighting their recurring unfaithfulness to the true God (Judges 8:33). This deity, also called Berith or Baalberith, was associated particularly with the Shechemites, as seen in their possession of a house dedicated to this god (Judges 9:4, 9:46). The worship of Baal Berith represents a turning away from covenantal faithfulness, underscoring the dangers of idolatry among God's people.
